_meta.scope: open-source doctor · COSMO intent-coverage ontology (public, built on the COSMO paper spirit)
_meta.note: COSMO (Amazon's commonsense knowledge graph, WWW 2024) has no official audit weights. This is a community concept-coverage check, NOT an official COSMO score. It measures whether a listing speaks to user intent across 4 commonsense dimensions, so sellers can spot listings that only stack product-attribute words and ignore why/for-whom/how users actually buy.

dimensions.use_case: where / what the product is used for (scenario + utility)
dimensions.goal: why the user buys it / what outcome they want (COSMO's signature dimension — often missing from attribute-stuffed listings)
dimensions.constraint: limits / qualifiers (when/where it does NOT apply)

_meta.scoring: score = target-line weighted (like alexa); coverage_ratio = matched/total (honest precision). goal is intentionally hard — low goal coverage flags attribute-stuffed listings.
_meta.matching: substring match (covers plural/inflection: comfort→comfortable, commute→commutes). concept words chosen from real listing vocabulary, not abstract phrases.
